messages.subject: PTT | Energy transition, institutional strategy and regional execution
messages.body:
Dear PTT Executive Leadership Team,

PTT's role at the center of Thailand's energy system makes the company a strong match for my experience across regulated industry, energy transition and senior stakeholder management.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate covers government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate coordination, social performance and executive stakeholder strategy across a major mining operation. I work directly with public institutions and internal technical teams on matters tied to energy, environment, investment, compliance and operating continuity.

My recent work includes stakeholder and governance support around approximately 46 to 50 MWp of solar capacity and more than 80 MWh of battery storage, together with carbon-data readiness based on physical operating records. I bring a practical understanding of how transition programs move from corporate ambition into regulatory, operational and community execution.

I would welcome consideration for Thailand, ASEAN or wider regional responsibilities in Corporate Affairs, Government Relations, Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships or country-facing leadership. I have attached a PTT-focused executive CV and would appreciate your routing it to the relevant executive or talent leader.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
